name: Clear Horizon Optometry
description: A crisp exam-room theme for optometrists and opticians: trial-lens rings with a 0–180° axis scale, a lit acuity chart that sharpens through the lens, eye tests laid out in a trial-lens case with durations and prices, a frames wall filterable by shape, material and fit, a children's vision path of tumbling Es from six months to school age, an appointment-card hours panel with an open-now status and a Jamstacks contact component for eye test and frames enquiries.
